name: 数学概念可视化

prompt_template.subject: {math_topic}
prompt_template.layout: coordinate system with labeled curves, regions, and annotations
prompt_template.style: clean mathematical diagram with axes, grids, and labeled entities
prompt_template.color_scheme: axes and grid in gray #6b7280, curves in primary blue #2563eb, highlighted regions in semi-transparent fill
prompt_template.labels: variables in italic, values on axes, formulas with LaTeX-style formatting, points labeled with coordinates

overrides.layout: 2D Cartesian plot with x-y axes, function curves, and key points marked
geometric figure with labeled sides, angles, and points
topological diagram with nodes, edges, and genus/manifold structure

overrides.style: probability distribution plot with density curve, mean/median/quantile markers, and shaded regions

category_tips.biology: 种群动态用 Logistic 方程；流行病学用 SIR 模型；神经活动用微分方程
category_tips.medicine: 药代动力学用浓度时间曲线；流行病学用 R0 标度；剂量反应曲线
category_tips.chemistry: 反应动力学用 Arrhenius 曲线；相图用 P-T 图；能级图用薛定谔解
category_tips.physics: 相空间用 Poincaré 截面；场论用费曼图；统计力学用配分函数曲线
category_tips.engineering: 控制理论用 Bode 图；信号处理用傅里叶变换；优化用收敛曲线
category_tips.math: 按数学分支：分析（极限/导数/积分）、几何（欧氏/非欧/拓扑）、代数（群/环/域）、概率（分布/随机过程/统计）

examples: Function plot of sine and cosine, Cartesian coordinate system from -2pi to 2pi on x-axis, -1.5 to 1.5 on y-axis. Two curves: sin(x) blue #2563eb, cos(x) red #ef4444, period 2pi. Key points marked at 0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2, 2pi with y-values. Grid lines light gray. Axes labels x and y in italic. Formula y=sin(x) and y=cos(x) as legend. 4K, publication-ready.

Geometry diagram of inscribed angle theorem. Circle with center O, points A, B, C on circumference. Central angle AOB marked at center, inscribed angle ACB marked at circumference subtending same arc AB. Angle measurements shown with arc. Theorem statement: inscribed angle = half of central angle. Bilingual labels 圆心角 (Central Angle), 圆周角 (Inscribed Angle). 4K.

Probability density plot of normal distribution N(mu=0, sigma=1). x-axis -4 to 4, y-axis 0 to 0.5. Bell curve in blue #2563eb. Mean at 0 with vertical dashed line. Standard deviation bands at ±1, ±2, ±3 shaded with decreasing opacity. 68-95-99.7 rule annotation. Formula f(x) = 1/(sigma*sqrt(2pi)) * exp(-(x-mu)^2/(2sigma^2)). 4K, statistics textbook style.
accuracy_tips: 坐标轴标签和单位准确；变量用斜体（x, y, theta）；公式用 LaTeX 排版或等效；曲线和点位置准确；几何定理标注重复；不虚构数学关系；分布参数标注；关键点坐标标注。
